games.title: Nova the Squirrel
games.description: A puzzle-focused platformer starring Nova, a green squirrel who can copy abilities from enemies. Inspired by Super Mario Bros. 3 and Kirby Super Star.

games.title: RoboRun
games.description: A 2D platformer with multiple levels, enemies, power-up stars and a countdown timer. Built for PAL/Dendy timing, so it plays slightly slower than NTSC games.

games.title: File Fixers
games.description: A computer-themed RPG for the NES, made for the GitHub Game Off 2021 game jam.

games.title: Stallar
games.description: An arcade game made for the Ludum Dare 50 game jam, whose theme was "Delay the Inevitable".

games.title: openNES Snake
games.description: The classic Snake (a.k.a. Nibbles) rebuilt for the NES as open source. Eat, grow, and do not bite your own tail.

games.title: 8-Bit Table Tennis
games.description: A two-player table tennis game. Press Start to begin, Up/Down to move and A to serve. First to 11 points wins.

games.title: Tobu Tobu Girl
games.description: An arcade platformer for the original Game Boy from Tangram Games.

games.title: µCity
games.description: A full city-building simulation for the Game Boy Color. Zone land, build services, balance the budget and handle disasters.

games.title: Geometrix
games.description: Line up rows or columns of three or more matching geometric shapes. Chain combos across three modes: Remove All, Swap Limit and Time Limit.

games.title: CrossConnect
games.description: A Numberlink puzzle game: connect every pair of matching nodes and fill the entire board. Hold A to draw lines, B to erase.

games.title: 2048gb
games.description: The addictive sliding-tile number puzzle 2048, ported to the original Game Boy.

games.title: AIRPLANZ
games.description: Two players, one Game Boy: an aerial dogfight written entirely in assembly.

games.title: GRIMLIGHT: The Hollow Bell
games.description: A turn-based gothic puzzle game. As the last lantern-keeper of Grimlight Manor, cross 30 rooms in six chapters to recover the stolen soul relics.

games.title: The Hat Chooses the Wizard
games.developer: Corwin & Gwilym Kuiper, music by Otto Halmén
games.description: A platformer for the Game Boy Advance, written in Rust with the agb library.

games.title: The Purple Night
games.developer: Corwin & Gwilym Kuiper, music by Sam Williams
games.description: An action platformer for the Game Boy Advance, written in Rust with the agb library.

games.title: Attack on Voxelburg
games.description: Fly over a 3D voxel terrain and destroy every enemy defense pod before they shoot you down. A: fly forward, B: shoot, L/R: strafe.

games.title: MeteoRain
games.description: Meteors are falling from the sky! Dodge them as long as possible for a high score. Made in Lua for GBA Jam 2021.

games.title: µCity Advance
games.description: The open-source city-building game for Game Boy Advance: a remake of the original µCity for Game Boy Color.
